title: The Ultimate Guide to Scalp Health
summary: Dandruff and itch usually start with an unbalanced scalp. Where to begin.
body:
Healthy hair starts with a healthy scalp. Dandruff, itchiness and oiliness often come from an unbalanced scalp.

## Cleanse the build-up

Just like your face, your scalp collects product build-up and dead skin. A herbal clarifying wash once a week keeps it calm.
